items.title: Solana Will Now Print Less SOL as Disinflation Vote Passes in Dramatic Fashion
items.whyYouShouldCare: The reduction in SOL issuance could enhance scarcity, potentially increasing the asset's value and impacting market dynamics.

items.title: Solana vote to double disinflation passes by a hair in dramatic finish
items.whyYouShouldCare: The narrowly passed vote to double disinflation reflects community support for tighter monetary policy, which may influence investor confidence and network stability.

items.title: Bitwise fund is first Solana ETF to hit $1 billion AUM
items.whyYouShouldCare: The Bitwise fund reaching $1 billion AUM signifies growing institutional interest in Solana, which could boost liquidity and ecosystem engagement.
